messages:
mariam: Heads-up — running a full attestation runthrough for the air-gapped site tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need to validate RBAC paths for the KMS proxy and make sure audit logs export works without egress.

aj: Thanks. Which RBAC specifically? kube roles for the kms-agent or higher-level app roles?

mariam: Primarily the kms-agent ServiceAccount in redwood-system and the attestation sidecar that needs to access /var/run/attest.sock. Also we need a short-lived rotate token flow tested.

claire: For the token rotate flow, add this to the role: 
```yaml
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "update"]
```
That allows the agent to write the ephemeral key blob. Keep scope to namespace.

nate: On audit logs — air-gapped customers still want tamper-evident logs. We can keep logs local + periodic signed hashes exported via airgap shuttle (no outbound TCP). Plan: write SHA256 of daily file to USB/collector during maintenance window.

mariam: @nate that sounds acceptable for now. We should also enable append-only journald and rsyslog signed-forwarding where possible.

sec-bot: new-incident created #INC-2029 for a low-priority vuln check in onprem runtime (see internal ticket).

aj: About KMS path — can someone post the healthcheck and config snippet for the kms-proxy? I want to validate network policy.

claire: quick healthcheck: 
```bash
kubectl -n redwood-system exec -it deploy/kms-proxy -- curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
# expected: {"status":"ok","keys":5}
```

claire: minimal NetworkPolicy to allow only kube-proxy and attestation pods to reach the proxy: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: kms-proxy-locked
  namespace: redwood-system
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: kms-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: attester
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
```

mariam: Nice. Also add an egress deny on the attester pods so they can't talk to anything but the proxy socket.

nate: Quick vuln triage note — kernel local privilege escalation CVE that affects some RHEL images. For air-gapped, we should verify base image versions and whether livepatch is in place. If not, apply containment: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and mount flags read-only where possible.

aj: For RBAC change rollout, recommend canary: patch one cluster in staging, run the attestation scenario, validate key rotation, then rollout to customer clusters. Anything to add to the checklist?

claire: Add these tests:
- attestation flow: attain nonce -> sign -> verify
- kms access: list keys -> encrypt/decrypt small payload
- audit tamper: modify log file locally and verify signed-hash mismatch detection

mariam: I'll own the run tomorrow, @aj please coordinate with infra for canary cluster. @sec-bot link INC-2029 and create a runbook stub in the incident ticket with steps above.

sec-bot: INC-2029 updated: runbook stub attached. Participants: mariam, aj, nate, claire.

nate: If we hit an unexpected KMS permission error, the first quick check is token expiry. Run: 
```bash
kubectl -n redwood-system logs deploy/kms-agent | tail -n 200 | grep -i token
```
If you see 401/403, rotate and redeploy the agent with new secret.

aj: Copying checklist into staging run. Will ping on #oncall if anything blocks. Good luck tomorrow. :thumbsup:

mariam: Thanks team. Will post a short summary after the run.
